commands.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
commit='1d6ee92adf6ccca38eeee64b1371cba1497e8fcd'
files=sorted(Path('crates/termrock-e2e/schemas').glob('*.json'))
changed=[]
for p in files:
 before=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'{commit}:{p.as_posix()}'])
 now=p.read_bytes()
 if hashlib.sha256(before).digest()!=hashlib.sha256(now).digest(): changed.append(p.as_posix())
print(f'schemas={len(files)} changed={changed}')
if len(files)!=12 or changed: raise SystemExit(1)
PY
